correctness.rationale: Exact positive ODE dynamics and the exponentially accurate comparison ceiling are derived. The scalar Hill ratio has the displayed sharp maximum. Below T_n=1 a strictly positive Metzler supersolution gives exponential extinction; at equality, a positive left nullvector, integrable positive drift and omega-limit equality argument eliminate all positive limiting infection, after which local hyperbolicity gives eventual exponential decay. Critical rational identities checked in verify.py; finite sampling is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source explicitly leaves the n>=2 global extinction picture incomplete and predecessor work shows backward bifurcation. An all-order, computable nonempty global-eradication subregion with a smallest possible environmental uniform majorant and a proved critical boundary is a motivated structural advance. The exact example succeeds with T_2=43/204 while the coarse total-population envelope fails at 5/3; a distinct admissible example realizes T_2=1. It neither renames a known table value nor pretends to settle the complete threshold.
